lead.purpose: The one dominant sentence under the title ("3 of 4 projects need attention"), 600, 1.0625rem/24px.

title.purpose: Section and card titles (h2), 600, 1.125rem/24px; card titles inside forms 15px/22px.

body.purpose: Lists, tables, reasons and forms, 400, 0.875rem/1.5. Never below 14px for running text.

label.purpose: Pills, column heads, dimension labels, confidence, 600 (pills) or 400, 0.75rem. The smallest size used.

score.purpose: Project score, 700, tabular: 1.125rem/24px in a row, 1.75rem/34px in the project header.

mono.purpose: IBM Plex Mono 400/500 for code, repository names, SHAs and versions only.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: No elevation: surfaces are separated by 1px hairlines, never by shadows.

shadows.name: pressed-ring
shadows.purpose: State only: pressed count filter and current project type segment.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transition: none !important; animation: none !important under prefers-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No motion grammar: state changes are instant; disclosures use native <details>.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Project header, environments path, security cards and data-quality rows stack vertically.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Generic tables become stacked label/value cards; side gutters drop to 16px.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Portfolio and workflow rows wrap into two lines (name, status and score first; bars and reason second); no horizontal page scroll.

breakpoints.name: catalog
breakpoints.purpose: Catalog editor: side list and form side by side.

focus.value: outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm)

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: 10px circle: filled vermilion / ochre / emerald for Critical / Attention / Healthy, a 1.5px dashed outline for Unknown (never a fill). Has an accessible name and always sits next to text.

components.name: Dimension Bars
components.description: Five 32px bars with a 4px gap (Delivery, Versions, Security, Coverage, Governance), 4px corners, bottom-aligned in a 12px box. Height repeats the state (WCAG 1.4.1): critical 12px, attention 8px, healthy 4px; unknown is a full-height dashed outline, no fill. Each bar has an accessible name such as "Security risk: Critical"; labels appear once in the list header.

components.name: Score
components.description: Project score 0–100 in 700 tabular figures with its confidence as visible secondary text ("measured 4 of 5"). With insufficient data: an em dash and "insufficient data", never 0.
components.html: 38measured 5 of 5 —insufficient data · measured 0 of 5

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: 12px/600 label on a fixed status tint, 999px radius, 3px 10px padding, shape icon before the text. Unknown is transparent with a dashed outline. Pills placed before text sit in a 112px column so the text aligns.
components.html: Critical Attention Healthy Unknown

components.name: Control Symbol
components.description: 24px box with one of six glyphs, same meaning everywhere: ✓ enabled, ! required but not configured, ⧖ stale scan, ✕ failed, ? not visible, – not required. The glyph carries the meaning and has an accessible name; colour is secondary.
components.html: ✓ ! ⧖ ✕ ? –

components.name: Count Filter
components.description: Status counts in the Portfolio title line double as the status filter: 40px high, hairline border, 8px radius, dot + 700 tabular value + label. Pressed: ink border with a 1px inset ink ring on the sunk surface.

components.name: Portfolio Row
components.description: One row per project, worst first, in a 10px-radius surface list: status dot, project link, score with confidence, five dimension bars, one-line main reason. 14px 16px cell padding, hairline row rules, sunk-surface hover. At 760px and below the row wraps into two lines.
components.html: Project Beta38measured 5 of 51 open critical alert

components.name: Dimension Card
components.description: Project page: one card per dimension (status dot, name, status pill, one-line summary) linking to its section. 16px padding, 10px radius, hairline border; an Unknown dimension shows a dashed dot and names the cause. No side-stripe borders.
components.html: Security risk1 open critical alert

components.name: Environments Path
components.description: DEV → UAT → PROD as cards (10px radius, 12px 16px padding, min 140px) joined by muted arrows; each shows the version in IBM Plex Mono and aligned / behind. Turns vertical at 640px and below.

components.name: Button
components.description: Secondary by default: surface ground, control-stroke border, 8px radius, ≥40px. The one primary action per view ("Propose on GitHub") is teal with ≥44px height.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Surface field, control-stroke border (3:1), 8px radius, ≥40px, 0.875rem text. Focus: 2px teal outline at 2px offset.

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Surface bar with a hairline under it: brand, then Portfolio, Security, Versions, Workflows, Data quality, Catalog (muted 500, 40px targets, 8px radius); the current page is ink on the sunk surface. "How to read", theme and language sit at the right.
components.html: Engineering Project HubPortfolioSecurityVersionsWorkflows

narrative.overview:
Warm Graphite is a reading instrument for a weekly portfolio review. Each page says one thing first (a single sentence such as "3 of 4 projects need attention"), then shows the list sorted worst first, and keeps the detail one click away. Character comes from restraint and precision: warm neutral greys, generous padding, hairline borders, one teal accent, and status colours used only where a status is.

Status is a small, exact mark rather than a painted area: a 10px dot, five 32px dimension bars whose height repeats the state, a pill on a fixed tint, a 24px control symbol. Vermilion, ochre and emerald fill those marks; darker *-text variants carry any text on their tints. Unknown is never a fill and never calm: it is a dashed outline in a dedicated stroke colour, with the cause named in words. A project score (0–100) sits next to the status dot with its confidence ("measured 4 of 5") always visible; when data is insufficient there is an em dash, never a 0.

Light and dark themes share hues and character; dark lifts the fills and inverts the tints onto a warm near-black. Both follow `prefers-color-scheme` and can be overridden with `[data-theme]`. Every text and graphic pair, including the fixed pill tints, is held to WCAG 2.2 AA by `tests/unit/tokens-contrast.test.ts`.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant sentence per page, then the list worst first, detail on demand.
Warm neutral greys; one teal accent for links, focus and the primary action, never for status.
Status as small exact marks (dot, dimension bars, pill, control symbol), always paired with text or an accessible name.
Unknown is a dashed outline with the cause in words: never a fill, never zero, never calmer than a gap.
Score next to the status, with visible confidence; insufficient data shows a dash and says so.
IBM Plex Sans with tabular figures; IBM Plex Mono only for code, repositories and versions.
8px controls, 10px cards and lists, 999px pills; 1px hairlines; no shadows, gradients or side stripes.

rules.name: The One Sentence Rule
rules.body: Every page opens with one sentence that states what matters now ("1 open critical alert · 3 required controls we cannot see"). Counts and filters follow it; they never replace it.

rules.name: The Accent Is Not Status Rule
rules.body: Teal is for links, focus rings and the single primary action. It never marks a health state, a severity or a count.

rules.name: The Dashed Unknown Rule
rules.body: Unknown, not authorised and collection failed are drawn with a 1.5px dashed `--unknown` outline and muted text, and the cause is named. They are never filled, never green, never shown as 0, and never visually calmer than an optional gap.

rules.name: The Fixed Tint Rule
rules.body: Pill and symbol tints are fixed OKLCH values per theme (not `color-mix`), so every `*-text` on its tint can be contrast-tested. Fills reach 3:1 on the surface as graphics; text variants reach 4.5:1 on their tint and on the surface.

rules.name: The Status Column Rule
rules.body: A pill placed before text sits in a fixed 112px column (`--status-col`) so the text after it starts at the same x on every row, whatever the label length.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Scores, counts, versions in tables and times use `tabular-nums`. A partial count is marked as incomplete; an unknown count is a dash with accessible text, never 0.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Surfaces are separated by 1px hairlines; the only inset ring marks a pressed state (count filter, current project type).

dos: **Do** start each page with one sentence, then the list sorted worst first; put detail in collapsible sections or on the project page.
**Do** pair every status mark with a text label or an accessible name; use the six control symbols with the same meaning everywhere.
**Do** draw unknown with the dashed `--unknown` outline and name the cause ("2 collection errors").
**Do** show the score with its confidence as visible text, and an em dash with "insufficient data" when fewer than half the dimensions are measured.
**Do** keep pills before text in the 112px status column.
**Do** keep touch targets at least 40px, and 44px for the primary action.
**Do** use IBM Plex Mono only for code, repository names, SHAs and versions.
donts: **Don't** render unknown, not authorised, collection failed or partial counts as 0, as a fill, or in green.
**Don't** use teal for status, or status colours for links.
**Don't** draw severity with health shapes or as health states; severity keeps its own scale and text labels.
**Don't** add side-stripe borders to cards, gradients, gradient text, glassmorphism or heavy shadows.
**Don't** add decorative KPI tiles that carry no decision.
**Don't** let colour be the only carrier of status.
**Don't** set running text below 14px or any label below 12px.
